title: App Pack Manifest
description: manifest.json - required for every App Pack directory.

id.description: Unique pack id. Lowercase start, [a-z0-9._-] afterwards, max 64 chars.

version.description: Pack version, e.g. "1.0.0". Used by continue_run to detect pack changes.

catalogVisibility.description: session: exposed to the MCP client; hidden: callable by id but not listed; internal: only callable from the pack's own workflows.

testedAgainst.description: OPTIONAL build-identity metadata: which executable / source revision this pack's selectors were verified against. Used to warn on selector drift (packCompatibility.mismatch) - never blocks launching. All fields optional; a pack is never required to know its git revision.

executable.description: Identity of the executable the pack was verified against.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the verified executable file.

appVersion.description: Application-level version this pack was verified against.

sourceRevision.description: Source revision (git hash etc.) the executable was built from.
